summary: Initial public release of the Low Carbon Fuel Standard web application. Establishes the core compliance reporting, fuel code management, organization administration, and transfer workflow foundations.

features: Core compliance reporting workflow: submission, analyst review, director decision, and supplemental reporting.
Fuel code management: create, edit, approve, and archive fuel codes.
Organization administration: manage fuel suppliers, government users, and role assignments.
Credit transfer workflow: initiate, review, and approve compliance unit transfers between organizations.
Final Supply Equipment (FSE) registration and management screens.
Public-facing pages: compliance unit calculator, approved carbon intensities bulletin, and credit trading market.
Keycloak-based authentication supporting both BCeID (industry) and IDIR (government) identity providers.
security: Role-based access control enforced at both API and UI layers.
Rate limiting and proxy-header handling delegated to Uvicorn to prevent spoofed-header attacks.
